folder.tooltip: Folder with the frames: an absolute path, or a folder inside ComfyUI's input folder. When several file types are present, the most common one is used.

start_frame.tooltip: Index of the first file to load (0 = the first in filename order).

frame_count.tooltip: Number of frames to load; 0 loads all of them. Long shots can be keyed in batches by stepping start_frame.

exr_output.tooltip: EXR only. linear: the plate's scene-linear values, for the Advanced keyer with input_colorspace linear. sRGB: converted to display sRGB and clipped to [0, 1], for nodes that expect normal images (and the Basic keyer).

output_tooltips: 'linear' or 'sRGB': what the images output holds.
CorridorKey2LoadImageSequence.name: CorridorKey2LoadImageSequence
CorridorKey2LoadImageSequence.description: Loads a folder of frames in filename order, like CorridorKey's own frame-folder input: EXR plates (scene-linear, values above 1.0 kept), 16-bit PNG/TIFF at full precision, or JPEG. For EXR plates set the Advanced keyer's input_colorspace to linear.
